name: Merret's Baby
description: Merret's nearly one-year-old son who, after tasting the elixir stain, lights candles with a sneeze, vanishes and reappears, and walks for the first time into Lazav's arms.

timeline.summary: Merret returns to his cramped home in Keyhole Village, where Tashi demands he find real food for the hungry baby.
timeline.quote: Get the food, Merret. I don't care how.

timeline.summary: Merret's baby, healthy after gnawing elixir-stained bread, sneezes and every candle in the apartment ignites.
timeline.quote: Then baby sneezes, and every single candle in our apartment bursts into flame.

timeline.summary: Wothis breaks into the apartment, beats Merret and demands the child, saying he saw the candle trick through the window.
timeline.quote: I saw what that child did through the window, the trick with the candles.

timeline.summary: Merret weaves a nightmare in Wothis's mind but loses focus when Wothis nears Soche, and Wothis seizes the baby.
timeline.quote: And like that, my baby is in Grimbly Wothis's arms

timeline.summary: The baby gets magically gripped, vanishes from Wothis's arms and reappears on the floor holding a strange purple star-shaped fruit.
timeline.quote: My son arches his back again, throws his arms up, and suddenly, he's gone.

timeline.summary: Merret notices Lazav sitting in the armchair, and the baby takes his first steps into Lazav's arms.
timeline.quote: Could this be Lazav? Lazav the Mastermind, Guildmaster of House Dimir?

timeline.summary: Lazav offers to pay Merret's debts, give a stipend, and send a tutor to teach the gifted baby, who stays with the family.
timeline.quote: we would like to ask that we send a tutor to your home to oversee his learning

pages_say.description: Merret's nearly one-year-old son who, after tasting the elixir stain, lights candles with a sneeze, vanishes and reappears, and walks for the first time into Lazav's arms.
